integrity: The proof uses only clauses (i) and (iii) of the source Main Theorem 1 and an elementary binary support-sum identity. The source clauses were checked in the public full text. A standalone exhaustive verifier checks the complete short-subcode support-spectrum implication for every binary source code of length at most \(4\) in independent surrogate extensions satisfying those two premises.
scientific_limitations: The exact equality \(d_r(A)=2d_r(C)\) is proved for \(1\le r\le\dim C\). Later generalized weights of the larger self-dual completion are not determined. The statement is binary and uses the source theorem\'s low-weight isolation threshold \(H\ge2m\).
title: Metric self-dual completion doubles the full source support hierarchy
